|Time|Ready queue|Analysis|
|--|--|--|
|0|**P1(5)**|Only P1 has arrived, so P1 is put on the processor|
|2|P2(4)|P2 arrives, but P1's time slice has not yet ended, so **no scheduling occurs for the moment**|
|4|P2(4)->P3(1)|P3 arrives, but P1's time slice has not yet ended, so no scheduling occurs for the moment|
|5|**P2(4)**->P3(1)->P4(6)|P4 arrives, and at the same time P1 finishes running. Scheduling occurs, and P2 is put on the processor|
|9|**P3(1)**->P4(6)|P2 finishes running; although its time slice is not used up, it voluntarily gives up the processor. Scheduling occurs|
|10|**P4(6)**|P3 finishes running; although its time slice is not used up, it voluntarily gives up the processor. Scheduling occurs|
|15|-|P4's time slice is used up, but the ready queue is empty, so P4 continues to execute for one more time slice|
